items.q: the name was Green -- Greenstreet -- Green -- I forget his name.

ctx.x: Wellman Braud, was it Wellman Braud?
No. Braud wasn't -- the name was Green -- Greenstreet -- Green -- I forget his name. I don't think Wellman Braud was playing with him. "Bro," I think how you think how you propounce that.
You know, Sonny Greer says "Bro," so maybe that's what it was.
